question: Lebang Boomani dance is the harvest dance of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lebang Boomani** is a traditional harvest dance of the state of **Tripura**.
 
• This dance is performed by the **Tripuri** people, an indigenous community in Tripura.
 
• The dance is typically performed to celebrate the harvest season, with dancers imitating the movements of catching grasshoppers (Lebang) which are believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the crops.
 
• Colorful attire and rhythmic music using traditional instruments like **drums and bamboo flutes** are characteristic of this dance form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tripura** is a state in Northeast India, **bordered by Bangladesh, Mizoram, and Assam**.
 
• The state's culture is a blend of traditional festivals, dance, music, and art forms, with the **Lebang Boomani** being one of the prominent cultural expressions.
 
• Tripura is also known for its diverse tribal communities and rich cultural heritage.
